spine: 1. 16 張 B300、FSDP／ZeRO-3 全參數微調 Qwen3-32B，團隊發現 nvidia-smi 的 utilization 在 NCCL 整個 deadlock 期間仍讀 100%，吞吐量卻是零——utilization 是會說謊的遙測。
2. 團隊原本懷疑的一個瓶頸是共享儲存 NFS——因為先前發生過一次「52k→21k tok/s」的崩潰；但受控 A/B 測試顯示 NFS 逐步讀取跟 pretokenized 本地快取的吞吐量差在 0.5% 以內，因為約 4GB 語料塞得進 4TB per-node RAM 的 page cache。
3. 那次崩潰被重新診斷為單執行緒 tokenize 加上壅塞的共享 NFS 造成的 CPU/NFS contention，不是儲存介質本身的問題。
4. 團隊用 board 功耗建了一張五段頻段表（compute ~940–1040W、communication ~640W、data starvation ~575W、deadlock ~190–195W、idle ~135W），藉此排除「通訊沒藏好」這個候選——健康時期 GPU 全程停在 compute 頻段，證明通訊確實被蓋在計算底下。

5. 真正的 deadlock 發生在 epoch 結束存 checkpoint 時：16 個 rank 裡有一個（rank 3）因為 persona 資料長度不一、切 packing block 時少了 53 個 block（0.17% 的差距），提早跑完迴圈走進 save barrier，其他 15 個 rank 還在做 gradient all-reduce，兩種 collective op 互相卡死，靜默了三小時才被 NCCL watchdog 抓到。
6. 修法 evenfix 讓每個 rank 在迴圈開始前先用 all_reduce 的 MIN 把自己的 block 數降到全域最小值，所有 rank 跑一樣的迭代次數，save barrier 的轉場天生對稱，deadlock 在結構上不可能發生。
7. 團隊把這次事故的代價量化成約 130 GPU·h，並加裝 2.71 秒的 pre-run 驗證 gate 加上一個獨立於訓練 session 的外部 watcher，把原本要三小時才會被人發現的靜默失敗，變成啟動前就被打回票。

perspective.mechanism: board 功耗依 workload phase（matmul-bound compute、NCCL 通訊、data starvation、deadlock、idle）落在不同區間，而 nvidia-smi 的 utilization 只回報『有沒有 kernel 在排程』，兩者在 deadlock 時會分岔，所以把功耗當作比 utilization 更誠實的遙測訊號。
perspective.tradeoff: 換用功耗 triage 需要先做一次 B300 專屬的頻段校準，且 Threats to Validity 一節明白說明這些 wattage 閾值換到別台硬體要重新校準，不能直接搬；NFS vs pretokenized cache 的結論也只在資料集塞得進 page cache 時成立，資料集遠大於 RAM 時會反過來。
perspective.reader_use: 在自己的多 GPU 訓練叢集上，先量幾個已知 healthy 跟已知 hang 的狀態各自的 board 功耗當基準線，再拿這個基準線去做故障分類，而不是死盯 nvidia-smi 的 utilization 欄位；上生產前的 invariant gate（cache 完整性、per-rank block 平衡、token 總量、埠是否被佔用、磁碟空間）也是可以直接抄的 checklist。

notes.quote: We report operational experience full-fine-tuning a 32.76B-parameter dense model (Qwen3-32B) on 16 x NVIDIA B300 (two nodes, FSDP / ZeRO-3) -- among the first published field accounts on this accelerator.
notes.interpretation: 確立整篇文章的規模與設定背景：16 張 B300、兩節點、FSDP/ZeRO-3、32.76B 參數的 Qwen3-32B。

notes.quote: (1) A B300-calibrated power-draw triage table that distinguishes compute / communication / data-starvation / checkpoint-or-deadlock / idle by board wattage (utilization% reads 100% during an NCCL hang).
notes.interpretation: 全文核心主張：utilization 在 NCCL hang 時仍讀 100%，功耗 triage 表是替代訊號。

notes.quote: nvidia-smi's utilization percentage reports only that a kernel is scheduled, not that it does useful compute... During a full NCCL deadlock utilization stays pinned at 100% even though throughput is exactly zero.
notes.interpretation: utilization 語義解釋——它量的是『kernel 有沒有被排程』，不是『有沒有做有用的工作』，這是解謎的核心機制。

notes.quote: ∼940–1040 W, 100%, uniform — compute (matmul-bound)—healthy
notes.interpretation: Table 3 compute 頻段的定義：940-1040W、utilization 均勻 100%，代表健康的矩陣運算階段。

notes.quote: ∼640 W, 100%, uniform — communication; if sustained, overlap failing
notes.interpretation: Table 3 communication 頻段：640W，若持續出現代表通訊沒有被計算蓋住。

notes.quote: ∼575 W, 55–100%, uneven — data starvation (stragglers)
notes.interpretation: Table 3 data starvation 頻段：575W、utilization 不均，代表部分 rank 在等資料。

notes.quote: ∼190–195 W, 1 rank 0% / rest 100% (deadlock) — hang / IO or rank 0 only 0% (checkpoint). In a deadlock the shape is asymmetric the other way—one rank at 0% and the rest pinned at 100% with power floored—and never recovers.
notes.interpretation: Table 3 deadlock 頻段：190-195W，一個 rank 0%、其餘 100% 的不對稱訊號，是解謎的關鍵判讀。

notes.quote: ∼135 W, 0%, all ranks — idle
notes.interpretation: Table 3 idle 頻段：135W、全部 rank 0%，用來跟 deadlock 的不對稱訊號做對照。

notes.quote: GPUs sat at ∼940–1040 W (compute regime) throughout, confirming communication was hidden behind compute.
notes.interpretation: 排除『通訊沒藏好』這個候選懷疑的直接證據：正常運行期間功耗全程停在 compute 頻段。

notes.quote: Path A — NFS per-step read + tokenize, cold (post drop_caches): 52.8k tok/s; warm: 53.0k tok/s. Path B — pretokenized packed node-local cache: 53.0k tok/s. All three are within ~0.5%.
notes.interpretation: 負面結果一：本地 pretokenized cache 相對 NFS 沒有帶來吞吐量優勢，三條路徑幾乎重疊。

notes.quote: The corpus is ~4 GB against 4 TB of per-node RAM, so after first touch it is resident in page cache; and even a true cold miss is cheap—a 32B FSDP step takes ~5 s while reading 4 GB cold takes ~3 s at the measured floor.
notes.interpretation: 解釋為何 NFS 追得上本地 cache：語料遠小於 per-node RAM，第一次讀過就進 page cache，冷讀也蓋得過一個訓練 step 的時間。

notes.quote: a sustained data-starvation collapse from 52k to 21k tok/s ... single-threaded tokenization (TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false, CPU load average ~15) and a contended, cooling shared NFS.
notes.interpretation: 先前那次吞吐量崩潰事件的原始數字與初步歸因：單執行緒 tokenize 加上壅塞的共享 NFS。

notes.quote: With parallel tokenization and an uncontended fabric, even a fully cold NFS read matches the local cache. The bottleneck was therefore tokenization-CPU throughput and NFS contention, never the storage medium.
notes.interpretation: 負面結果二：重新診斷後，那次崩潰的根因是 CPU/NFS contention，不是儲存介質本身。

notes.quote: 4 GPUs, 0.5 nodes, 13.4k tok/s, 3,350 tok/s/GPU, 20.9h/epoch, 83.7 GPU-h, 100% eff; 8 GPUs, 1 node, 26.7k tok/s, 3,338 tok/s/GPU, 10.5h, 84.1 GPU-h, 100% eff; 16 GPUs, 2 nodes (IB), 53.0k tok/s, 3,313 tok/s/GPU, 5.3h, 84.7 GPU-h, 99% eff. Per-GPU throughput is flat within ~1% (3,313–3,350) and GPU·h per epoch is conserved at ~84.
notes.interpretation: Table 7 強擴展參考數字：4/8/16 GPU 的吞吐量、per-GPU 吞吐量、epoch 時長、GPU·h、效率，近乎線性。

notes.quote: 1. Cache integrity + per-rank block balance 2. Token-total sanity (~1.01B ±10%) 3. GPU occupancy ≠0 on both nodes 4. master_port free 5. Checkpoint disk headroom (≥150 GB) 6. (optional) IB bus-bandwidth probe. Measured wall-clock to run all six checks across both nodes: 2.71 s.
notes.interpretation: Table 6 preflight gate 的六項檢查內容與總耗時 2.71 秒。

notes.quote: Rank 3 ran out 53 blocks (≈7 optimizer steps, at 8 blocks/step) before rank 11, exited the loop, and walked into the save barrier while others reduced gradients. The 53-block spread is 0.17% of the per-rank workload—invisible to every metric except the one that mattered.
notes.interpretation: deadlock 根因的核心敘述：rank 3 因少 53 個 block 提早結束迴圈，走進 save barrier 造成 collective op 互相卡死。

notes.quote: The loader shards rows evenly, but persona records vary in length, so the per-rank token count varies and, after packing into 2048-token blocks, the block counts differ (min: 30,835; max: 30,888).
notes.interpretation: 解釋 block 數量不平衡的機制：loader 按列平均切分，但 persona 紀錄長度不一，packing 後 block 數不再相等，最小 30,835、最大 30,888。

notes.quote: A from-pretrained run progressed normally for ∼5 hours: loss 1.60→0.74→∼0.68, throughput ∼53k tok/s, all 16 GPUs at 100% utilization. At step 3,850 of 3,857—entering the end-of-epoch checkpoint—all 16 GPUs hung for three hours until the NCCL watchdog surfaced it. No dmesg OOM, no segfault, no error: pure silence, with utilization still reading 100%.
notes.interpretation: 整起事故的時間軸：五小時正常運行、loss 數字、進入 checkpoint 的確切 step、三小時卡死、watchdog 才發現，且沒有任何常見錯誤訊號。這是 hero widget 的資料來源。

notes.quote: Before the loop, each rank reduces its local block count to the global minimum: local_blocks = file_bytes // 4 // seq_len; min_blocks = dist.all_reduce(torch.tensor(local_blocks), op=ReduceOp.MIN); if blk_idx >= min_blocks: break. All ranks now run an identical number of iterations, so the terminal save-barrier transition is symmetric and the deadlock is structurally impossible.
notes.interpretation: evenfix 修法的完整機制：每個 rank 用 all_reduce MIN 把 block 數降到全域最小值，迴圈統一停下，讓 deadlock 在結構上不可能發生。

notes.quote: A session-independent watcher on a separate host detects completion (epoch checkpoint appears), crash (process gone, no checkpoint), hang (step counter stalls, or the power/utilization deadlock signature persists across two samples).
notes.interpretation: 外部 watcher 的三種判斷邏輯：完成、崩潰、卡住（含功耗/利用率 deadlock 訊號連續兩次採樣仍在）。

notes.quote: The hang itself (16 GPU × ∼3 h before watchdog): ∼48 GPU·h. Unrecoverable progress (pre-fix epoch-end-only save; ∼5 h × 16 GPU): ∼85 GPU·h. Total per incident: ∼130 GPU·h.
notes.interpretation: 這次事故的量化成本：卡住本身 48 GPU·h，加上白跑的進度 85 GPU·h，總計約 130 GPU·h。

notes.quote: The transferable takeaways are operational: watch power, not utilization, and verify invariants before launch—a passing smoke test is not evidence of a safe full run.
notes.interpretation: 結論一節的方法論收尾，直接對應本文 closer 的兩句話。

notes.quote: This is an experience report. We do not introduce a new training algorithm, a new parallelism strategy, or a new optimizer. Instead we share what it actually took to operate a multi-node full fine-tuning job on NVIDIA B300—brand-new hardware (Blackwell Ultra, 2025–26) for which little operational experience is yet public.
notes.interpretation: Introduction 開場，定位這篇為操作層面的實戰報告，並指出 B300（Blackwell Ultra）公開實戰經驗稀少。

notes.quote: Authors: Seon Ho Kim, Ui Jeong Jeon, Su Hyeon Kim, Min Tae Hwang. Institution: Samsung SDS.
notes.interpretation: 作者與機構資訊，用於 intro 的具體歸屬色彩。

notes.quote: We measured to 16 GPUs / 2 nodes. The deadlock mechanism is scale-independent, but the efficiency numbers (§6) should not be extrapolated past the two-node IB boundary. The generality argument is structural, not empirical across models. The §3 wattages are B300 values; the taxonomy and shape discriminators should transfer, absolute thresholds must be re-calibrated. The §4 conclusion holds only while the dataset fits in page cache; it inverts for datasets >> RAM.
notes.interpretation: Threats to Validity and Scope 一節的完整限制聲明：規模外推限制、單一模型未經驗證、B300 專屬閾值需重新校準、page cache 前提。用於文中多處明確保留 hedge，不讓結論過度外推。

notes.quote: 5.4 Prior art: this is Join / drop_last, at the packing layer
notes.interpretation: 論文把這次 deadlock 歸類為分散式訓練裡熟悉的 Join/drop_last 失敗模式家族，只是發生在 packing 層而非樣本層。

claims.claim_text: 更早之前，這套 pipeline 發生過一次「52k → 21k tok/s」的吞吐量崩潰，當時被歸咎給共享儲存 NFS。
claims.evidence: a sustained data-starvation collapse from 52k to 21k tok/s … The earlier incident is real; our initial framing of it as a 'storage bottleneck' was imprecise, and we correct it here.
claims.note: Both the figures and the initial misattribution are verified — the paper explicitly owns and corrects its earlier framing.

claims.claim_text: 肇因是單執行緒 tokenize（TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false，CPU load average 大約 15）疊加上一段壅塞、正在冷卻的共享 NFS……瓶頸從頭到尾都是 tokenize 的 CPU 吞吐量跟 NFS 的併發爭用，從來不是儲存介質本身太慢。
claims.evidence: The collapse occurred under single-threaded tokenization (TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false, CPU load average ~15) and a contended, cooling shared NFS. … With parallel tokenization and an uncontended fabric, even a fully cold NFS read matches the local cache. The bottleneck was therefore tokenization-CPU throughput and NFS contention, never the storage medium.
claims.note: Env-var name, load average, the embedded English quote and the causal conclusion all verified verbatim without strengthening.

claims.claim_text: 那五個小時的正常 run 裡，GPU 全程停在 940 到 1040 瓦，「confirming communication was hidden behind compute」
claims.location: under H2「懷疑二：這次也是通訊沒藏好嗎？」
claims.evidence: GPUs sat at ~940-1040 W (compute regime) throughout, confirming communication was hidden behind compute.
claims.note: Verbatim match in section 6. This is the elimination step the investigation turns on.

claims.location: widget-visible text — vg-w-pop-b300-scaling row and its three popovers

claims.claim_text: loader 是按「列」平均切給每個 rank 的，但每一筆 persona 紀錄的長度不一樣……最少的一個 rank 是 30,835 個 block，最多是 30,888 個，差了 53 個。
claims.location: under H2「真正的原因：一個 rank 比別人少算了 53 個 block」
claims.evidence: The loader shards rows evenly, but persona records vary in length, so the per-rank token count varies and, after packing into 2048-token blocks, the block counts differ (min: 30,835; max: 30,888).
claims.note: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED — this is what the sidecar summary rests on. 30,888 - 30,835 = 53, and the rank identification is the paper's own.

claims.claim_text: 53 個 block 換算成優化器步數，大約是 7 步（每 8 個 block 對應 1 個 optimizer step）。「The 53-block spread is 0.17% of the per-rank workload」……分到最少 block 的 rank 3 提早跑完自己的迴圈，直接走進 epoch 結尾的 save barrier
claims.evidence: Rank 3 ran out 53 blocks (~7 optimizer steps, at 8 blocks/step) before rank 11, exited the loop, and walked into the save barrier while others reduced gradients. The 53-block spread is 0.17% of the per-rank workload—invisible to every metric except the one that mattered.
claims.note: 0.17%, ~7 optimizer steps, 8 blocks/step and rank 3's early exit all verified verbatim; 53/30,888 = 0.17% is internally consistent.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 的 DDP 文件早就描述過這種失敗模式……PyTorch 官方給的解法是 Join 這個 context manager，或者乾脆設定 drop_last=True
claims.evidence: That uneven per-rank inputs desynchronize collectives and hang the job is the stated motivation for DistributedDataParallel.join() … The tutorial states it directly: 'if a rank has fewer inputs, then the other ranks will hang or error.' The standard remedy … is DataLoader(drop_last=True).
claims.note: Trace thin (n26 carries only the section heading) but authenticity clean: every element is genuinely in section 5.4. Independence recorded as single-source because the PyTorch docs are reached only through this paper's citation.

claims.claim_text: 讓每個 rank 在進迴圈前，先用一次 all_reduce 把自己的 block 數量降到全 domain 的最小值……deadlock 在結構上不可能再發生
claims.location: under H2「真正的原因」— prose plus the pseudocode block
claims.evidence: local_blocks = file_bytes // 4 // seq_len; min_blocks = dist.all_reduce(torch.tensor(local_blocks), op=ReduceOp.MIN); if blk_idx >= min_blocks: break. All ranks now run an identical number of iterations, so the terminal save-barrier transition is symmetric and the deadlock is structurally impossible.
claims.note: Code lines and the structural-impossibility conclusion verified verbatim; the post's block is labelled pseudocode and drops the dist./torch wrappers while keeping the operative semantics.

claims.claim_text: 跑六項檢查……六項全部跑完，兩個 node 合計量到的時間是 2.71 秒。
claims.location: under H2「把三小時的靜默，變成 2.71 秒就打回票」— prose plus vg-w-stack-b300-preflight
claims.evidence: 1. Cache integrity + per-rank block balance 2. Token-total sanity (~1.01B +/-10%) 3. GPU occupancy !=0 on both nodes 4. master_port free 5. Checkpoint disk headroom (>=150 GB) 6. (optional) IB bus-bandwidth probe. Measured wall-clock to run all six checks across both nodes: 2.71 s.
claims.note: All six checks and the 2.71 s wall-clock verified, including the optional status of the IB probe.

claims.claim_text: 負責從外部判斷三種狀態：完成、崩潰、卡住（step 計數器停滯不動，或者「the power/utilization deadlock signature persists across two samples」
claims.evidence: A session-independent watcher on a separate host detects completion (epoch checkpoint appears), crash (process gone, no checkpoint), hang (step counter stalls, or the section 3 power/utilization deadlock signature persists across two samples).
claims.note: All three detection branches and the embedded English quote verified.

claims.claim_text: 卡住本身耗掉大約 48 GPU·h……又賠上大約 85 GPU·h，一次事故總共大約 130 GPU·h

claims.claim_text: 換算下來，相當於一台 16 張 GPU 的機器平白多跑了超過 8 個小時
claims.note: Already marked as the author's derivation by the in-text 「換算下來」. Arithmetic checks out on a verified base: ~130 GPU-h / 16 = 8.125 h. The paper does not state this per-machine figure.
